mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_id, product_id, rating, content, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.id AS u_id, u.username AS u_username FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT r.*, u.id AS u_id, u.username AS u_username, p.name AS p_name FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM review WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT r.*, u.id AS u_id, u.username AS u_username FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
